chapter_keywords: grand dao of wood and water
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era: The Final Six Face Off in the Immortal Fortunes Assembly
chapter_meta_description: The stakes are absolute as the Immortal Fortunes Assembly enters its critical round. Ji Ning, Xiamang Zishan, and the others prepare for a battle that will decide who earns a Daofather’s favor.
og_description: Six Wanxiang Adepts, one hour of enforced stillness, and a battle that will decide who earns Daofather Crimsonbright’s favor. The Immortal Fortunes Assembly reaches its breaking point.
twitter_description: Ji Ning faces Xiamang Zishan while Mu Chuan drops a shocking hidden card—dual Grand Daos. The Immortal Fortunes Assembly reaches its critical point.

lore_anchors.definition: The supreme Daofather overseeing the Immortal Fortunes Assembly; a major power of the Three Realms who will take one of the final six as his personal disciple.
The Celestial Thearch of the Grand Xia Dynasty, a Pure Yang True Immortal who orchestrates the final rounds of the assembly with cold precision.
A seemingly simple but immensely powerful Wanxiang Adept; already a disciple of the Black Tortoise Grand Emperor.
A deceptively humble genius who has been hiding his mastery of two Grand Daos (Verdant Wood and Source Water) for three hundred years.
A Grand Dao governing the properties of wood, growth, and life force; combined with Source Water, it becomes a devastatingly fluid defense.
A Grand Dao governing the properties of water, flow, and adaptability; complements Verdant Wood in Mu Chuan's dual-Dao fighting style.
A proud, overbearing imperial prince of the Xiamang clan; renowned for his devastating staff technique and brute force.
A mysterious barefoot, bald youth wielding a staff; suspected by the watching Immortals of having a connection to Fuxi.
A divine form that multiplies a cultivator's offensive and defensive capabilities by manifesting extra limbs.
A secret art employed by the Slacker Daoist that layers attacks for increasing power, similar to crashing waves that build in intensity.
The designated arena for the final battles of the Immortal Fortunes Assembly; a sealed space that contains all combat force.
